title: Book Three · Chapter 143: A Page of His Own
story:
On Monday, Ronan takes his course sheet to the school library.

The music afternoon is over. He has returned the checked list to the teacher. Now he wants information about his own next lessons.

The librarian helps him find two books. One describes further study. The other describes practical training and work.

Ronan puts them side by side at a small table.

He starts with the practical book. There are shop examples, office messages, and simple accounts.

He likes the messages. The pages of numbers take longer.

He reads one example twice, then copies the little sum onto his own sheet. A price is missing from the first total. He finds it on the next line and starts again.

Anna comes with her maths book after lunch. She sits opposite him and puts a folded drawing beside it.

“More information?” she asks.

“More numbers.”

“They follow you.”

He smiles. “They were here first.”

She opens her own work. For a while, both read quietly.

Ronan gets the second total right. He checks it against the answer, then puts a mark beside the example.

“This part needs practice,” he says.

Anna looks up. “Do you still want it?”

“I want to learn more. I like the work with people. I need this part too.”

She nods and turns her drawing toward him.

Her stair is wider now. She has changed two lines after Friday's talk with the teacher.

“Mine needs more work too.”

Ronan follows the steps with his finger. They lead to a bright open place at the top.

“I can see the way.”

Anna smiles and folds the sheet carefully.

At the end of lunch, Ronan returns the two library books to the shelves. Ronan keeps his own notes and the course reply.

The six Saturday mornings have no confirmed starting date yet. He has paid no class fee. His work envelope still holds twenty-one yuan at home.

He writes the centre's address below his questions for later use. Then he puts the page away beside his school book.

Outside, the autumn wind moves dry leaves across the path. Anna catches one against her shoe and lifts it by the stem.

“A small roof,” she says.

Ronan looks at the curved leaf.

“Room for one ant.”

She laughs and puts it beside the tree. He gives her his hand, and they walk back toward the classroom with their books under their other arms.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

further study＝继续深造、进一步学习；account＝账目；confirmed＝已确认的；stem＝叶柄、茎。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan喜欢哪部分、又发现哪部分需要练习？他是否已经定好或报上课程？
2. Anna自己的楼梯图怎样继续进展？两人是否必须做同一种学习选择？

## 读句子

**The pages of numbers take longer.**

拆开看：The pages of numbers / take / longer.

那些数字较多的书页／需要／更长时间来读。
